annotations.title: Signed Phantom Allowlist: Payable x402 Sellers

description: Return an HMAC-signed allowlist of x402 sellers with probe evidence (402 seen, probe ok, last paid ok). Use when you want a signed list of already-vetted x402 sellers before spending. Not for checking one specific URL (use phantom-seller-scan) or raw unvetted discovery leads (use agent-lead-pack). Pick this when the question is 'whom can I safely pay?'. Returns a free sample plus the paid URL and pay steps (no charge here); the full result costs $0.03 Base USDC via x402.

query.description: Input for the paid endpoint: optional max sellers (1-40).
